title: Why Rubio's India visit went to a refinery, not Delhi

scenes.title: Rubio skipped Delhi for a refinery. Here's why it matters
scenes.say: America's Secretary of State came to India, and skipped New Delhi. Here's why that matters.

scenes.title: Mumbai and Jamnagar, 20–21 October

pins.label: New Delhi: not on the list

scenes.say: Marco Rubio's two-day visit on 20 and 21 October centred on Mumbai's boardrooms and Reliance's giant refinery at Jamnagar, not the capital.
scenes.speak: Marco Rubio's two-day visit on the twentieth and twenty-first of October centred on Mumbai's boardrooms and Reliance's giant refinery at Jamnagar, not the capital.

scenes.title: Ministers, then moguls

items.what: S. Jaishankar, and the UAE's foreign minister

scenes.say: He held talks with S. Jaishankar and the UAE's foreign minister, met the Tata, Adani and Reliance groups, then flew to Jamnagar.

scenes.title: A transactional agenda
scenes.say: Washington wants India to buy more American energy, refine Venezuelan crude, open its market, and do deals with its biggest companies.

scenes.title: Does a deal make India more secure?
scenes.say: For India, the test is simple. Does any new energy deal come at a competitive price, secure supply, and avoid a new kind of dependence?

scenes.title: Three signals
items: Defence and tech still on track
scenes.say: Watch three things: a signed and balanced trade deal, energy bought on competitive terms, and defence and technology ties that stay on track.

scenes.text: The measure of a strategic partnership is whether both countries can sustain cooperation when their immediate interests diverge.
scenes.say: In the end, a partnership is measured by whether it holds when interests diverge.
